name: Global Objective Obfuscation and Algebraic Edge Translation
description: Replaced the local "product is 2" affordance with a mathematically equivalent GCD condition to prevent immediate bipartite recognition. Replaced the "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with a global base-10 sum minimization to deter greedy component-wise heuristics and trap naive implementations in BigInt overflows, forcing genuine reasoning about the structural equivalence.
